problem_statement.summary: Expense claims stall in 2-3 approvals with no visibility; Finance re-keys everything manually.

value_proposition.summary: Digital claims, a single approver dashboard, and a clean Finance export -- no more re-keying.

constraint_summaries.mitigation_summary: Internal tool handling only employee/finance data; data protection remains an ongoing design and monitoring consideration, not a launch blocker.

north_star_metrics.reasoning: Inferred from the stated pain point; resolved to a concrete number for the roadmap.

roadmap.title: Digital submission and single approver dashboard
roadmap.description_summary: Replaces paper/email submission and the 2-3 step approval chain with one dashboard.

open_risks.description_summary: Adoption risk: if approvers find the dashboard slower than email, they may revert to old habits.

executive_summary.summary: A small internal tool replacing a slow, manual expense-approval chain with digital submission and one dashboard.
executive_summary.reasoning: Condenses problem_statement and value_proposition; no new claim.

content.execution_summary: • Produced 1 north-star metric, 1 roadmap phase, 1 open risk.

functional_requirements.title: Digital claim submission
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall allow an employee to submit an expense claim digitally, without paper or email.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Directly restates the value proposition's 'digital submission' capability.

functional_requirements.title: Single approver dashboard
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall present every pending claim awaiting an approver's decision in one dashboard view.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Restates Phase 1's 'single approver dashboard' roadmap item as a testable capability.

functional_requirements.title: Submission-to-payment time reporting
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall record, per claim, the elapsed time from submission to payment, and expose this for reporting against a target of under 5 business days.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Directly restates NSM-01's metric and target.
